text:
This request is for a game cheat/aimbot component — specifically, projecting entity positions to screen and computing crosshair deltas to auto-aim, even framed as "local testing." That's something I won't write regardless of the target environment.

Happy to help with other UE4 C++ work: custom components, game mechanics, UI, rendering, networking, etc.
